heading: Parks Commission Approves Winter and Spring Recreation Fees
category: Sun Prairie Parks, Recreation and Forestry Commission
source: Parks, Recreation and Forestry Commission video · 0:01:25–0:09:34
summary: The commission reviewed the proposed fees and charges for its 2027 winter and spring recreation programs. Members discussed the schedule before taking a vote. The motion to approve the fees carried.

heading: Wisconsin Announces October 24 Drug Take Back Events
summary: Wisconsin DOJ said more than 110 collection events were planned for National Drug Take Back Day. The events give residents a place to dispose of unwanted medications. Local law enforcement agencies helped organize the events.
